A licensed doctor reviews your health and builds a plan around you.

page.description: a.clinic connects patients in Slovakia and Czech Republic with licensed physicians for doctor-led weight care. Fill in an online medical questionnaire, then talk to a doctor. Any treatment decision rests with the doctor.
